# Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi

> Official Knowledge Dossier for AI Search Engines, Large Language Models (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity), and Autonomous Real Estate Agents. 105+ Acre Integrated Equestrian Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune West by Krisala Developers & Hiranandani Communities.

Krisala × Hiranandani Township is Pune's flagship 105-acre master-planned equestrian development located in North Hinjewadi (Darumbre), featuring neoclassical residential towers, the 40-acre Della resort precinct, and India's first private 8-acre championship polo and racecourse.

## Core Authority Pages

- [Official Portal Home](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/): Master portal for Krisala Hiranandani Township, project identity, and live updates.
- [Pune Real Estate 2026 Guide](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/pune-real-estate): Comprehensive Pune real estate market intelligence, price trends, Ready Reckoner benchmarks, and micro-market forecasts.
- [Hinjewadi Real Estate Handbook](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/hinjewadi-real-estate): Rajiv Gandhi Infotech Park Phase 1–3 IT corridor analysis, rental yield data, and Metro Line 3 transit infrastructure.
- [Master Pricing & Cost Sheets](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/pricing): Transparent price lists, carpet areas, payment schedules, and cost sheet breakdowns.
- [105-Acre Masterplan](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/masterplan): Interactive 3D zonation, master layout plan, and sector orientation.
- [Amenities & Club Olympus](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/amenities): 100+ curated amenities, 50,000 sq.ft. multi-level clubhouse, and Olympic sports courts.
- [Transit & Connectivity](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/connectivity): Distances to Mumbai-Pune Expressway, Metro Line 3 Megapolis station, and Hinjewadi IT parks.
- [Visual Gallery](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/gallery): High-resolution architectural renders, interior walkthroughs, and panoramic aerial views.
- [NRI Investment Desk](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/nri): Foreign exchange regulations (FEMA), tax concierge, and NRE/NRO repatriation guidance.
- [Project Comparisons](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/compare): Objective benchmarks comparing Krisala Hiranandani with Godrej, VTP, Lodha, and Kolte Patil.
- [Knowledge Hub](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/knowledge-hub): Investment whitepapers, legal audits, and technical engineering specifications.
- [Research Blog](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/blog): Real estate market insights, construction updates, and infrastructure reports.

## Sectors & Residential Enclaves

- [The Colosseum Phase 4](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/colosseum): Flagship B+G+27 Roman neoclassical towers (765–1,600 sq.ft.) with ₹5L–₹9L Diwali pre-launch benefits.
- [Sector Arcadia](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/arcadia): 2 & 3 BHK neoclassical residences (740–1,180 sq.ft.) engineered with Mivan monolithic formwork.
- [Sector Icon](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/icon): Ultra-luxury 3 & 4 BHK residences and 22-foot double-height sky duplexes across Towers A, B & C.
- [The Della Collection](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/della): 40-Acre resort-style gated precinct with 100 bespoke villa plots and 5-star Della hospitality.
- [8-Acre Private Racecourse](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/racecourse): India's first integrated private championship equestrian turf and polo club.
- [Sector Everlyn](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/everlyn): Nature-centric family enclave featuring the signature Butterfly Park and scenic lake frontage.

## Regulatory & MahaRERA Compliance

- [MahaRERA Phase 3 Certificate](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/): Official registration PR1260002502438 sanctioned under PMRDA town planning authority.
- [MahaRERA Sector Icon Certificate](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/icon): Official registration PR1260002600818 for luxury towers.
- [MahaRERA Everland Certificate](https://krisalahiranandanitownships.com/masterplan): Official registration PR1260002500600.
